podcast.title: Influence on Future Artists
podcast.body: Noel Coward continued to make music for West End and Broadway in the mid-1960s, which introduced his work to a new generation, including a young David Bowie, the future founder of Roxy Music, and Alice Cooper. "And this is how a new generation learned about him, and that included a young David Bowie, and the young man who would later form Roxy Music, and Alice Cooper."

xref.title: Early Influence from Noel Coward
xref.body: As a young man, David Bowie was introduced to the work of Noel Coward, who was still making music for the West End and Broadway in the mid-1960s, contributing to Bowie's understanding of style and showmanship. "And this is how a new generation learned about him, and that included a young David Bowie."
